simple.summary: חֲצַר עֵינוֹן (Chătsar ʻÊynôwn) means Chatsar-Enon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Ezek 47 17.

definitions.full: H2703. Chatsar Enon ׳ח עֵינָן עֵינוֺן, חֲצַר proper name, of a location on northeast border of Canaan Ezek 47:17 ; עֵינָן חֲצַר 48:1 (Co in both עֵינוֺן חָצֵ֫רָךְ ); ׳ח עֵינָן Num 34:9-10 , where it is said ( 34:9 ) צָפוֺן גְּבוּל לָכֶם יִהְיֶה זֶה ; ᵐ5 Αρσεναιειμ , ᵐ5 L Ασερναιν ; — see also הַתִּיכוֺן חָצֵר below
definitions.rootNote: from 2691 and a derivative of 5869 ; village of springs;
